verdict.rationale: ADK ships a built-in development web UI for testing and debugging agents (`adk web`). It also offers lifecycle callbacks for logging and monitoring, and tracks token usage. That points to some run-inspection capability, but nothing in the evidence explicitly describes a trace view of each LLM call and tool invocation. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-call trace/span visualization of LLM and tool invocations in the UI, any observability/tracing integration (e.g. OpenTelemetry or third-party backends), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
